comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
The path in your crash points to a build output folder on the maintainer's dev machine (`D:\github\mRemoteNG\mRemoteNG\bin\x64\Release\Settings`). This means the `.exe` being run was launched from inside the cloned source tree, not from a packaged build.

Grab a proper release or nightly ZIP / MSI from the [releases page](https://github.com/robertpopa22/mRemoteNG/releases) and the Settings folder will be created under `%APPDATA%\mRemoteNG` (or next to the exe in portable mode).

comments.snippet: Closing as not-a-bug — the crash was triggered by running `mRemoteNG.exe` from a source-tree build output on a machine where that path does not exist. Using a packaged release or nightly ZIP/MSI avoids the issue. Reopen if it reproduces from a packaged build.
